description: This file declares the interface for the UnsortedSegmentSumSPMDExpander class, which is part of the TensorFlow DTensor MLIR expansions. It includes class definitions, method signatures for layout computation and operation expansion, and external dependencies related to MLIR and TensorFlow DTensor components.
external_methods: StatusOr<llvm::DenseMap<int, Layout>> ComputeLayoutForward(mlir::Operation* op, const llvm::DenseMap<int, Layout>& input_layouts)
StatusOr<llvm::DenseMap<int, Layout>> ComputeLayoutBackward(mlir::Operation* op, const llvm::DenseMap<int, Layout>& output_layouts)

classes.name: UnsortedSegmentSumSPMDExpander
classes.description: A class responsible for expanding and computing layouts for the unsorted segment sum operation in the MLIR framework within TensorFlow's DTensor architecture.

methods.name: ExpandOp
methods.description: Expands a given MLIR operation associated with unsorted segment sum for SPMD layout logic.

methods.name: ComputeLayoutForward
methods.description: Computes the forward layout propagation for the operation based on input layouts.

methods.name: ComputeLayoutBackward
methods.description: Computes the backward layout propagation for the operation based on output layouts.
